title: Toledo's Aeden Cereño shines with bronze in world poomsae championships

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Bemedaled taekwondo poomsae athlete Aeden Roffer Cereño put his hometown Toledo City on the international taekwondo map anew. The Cebuano taekwondo jin earned a bronze medal in the mixed team under-17 poomsae category of the ongoing Chuncheon 2026 World Taekwondo Poomsae Championships in Chuncheon, South Korea, on Saturday, September 19, 2026. Two Cebuano and Toledo City taekwondo jins are competing in South Korea. Cereño and Clarissa Louise Gallego are with the rest of the Philippine taekwondo team in the ongoing poomsae world championships.
